info.name: Riwaq Backend
info.description: Current Riwaq Backend API collection. Protected requests use Authorization: Bearer {{firebaseToken}} with a validated Firebase ID token. Replace placeholder IDs with values returned by the API.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Firebase Authentication uses a Firebase ID token. Put the token in the collection variable firebaseToken; protected requests automatically send Authorization: Bearer {{firebaseToken}}. The login request verifies an ID token and provisions or reuses the local user.

request.description: Anonymous endpoint. Send a real Firebase ID token in idToken. Success example: {"userId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","firebaseUid":"firebase-uid","points":50,"learningDirectionId":null,"isNewUser":true}. Invalid or expired tokens return 401.

item.name: Users
item.description: Authenticated user profile operations. The backend derives the local user from the validated token; no user ID is accepted for the current-user operations.

request.description: Returns the authenticated local user's profile. Success example: {"userId":"...","firebaseUid":"...","points":50,"learningDirectionId":null,"firstName":null,"lastName":null,"bio":null,"university":null}.

Updates only the authenticated user's profile. Success example: {"userId":"...","firebaseUid":"...","points":50,"learningDirectionId":null,"firstName":"Ada","lastName":"Lovelace","bio":"Backend developer","university":"Analytical University"}.

Assigns an existing Skill as the authenticated user's learning direction. Success example: {"userId":"...","learningDirectionId":"...","points":50}. Invalid skillId returns 404; an empty GUID returns 400.

Anonymous public profile lookup. Success example: {"userId":"...","points":50,"learningDirectionId":null,"learningDirectionName":null,"firstName":"Ada","lastName":"Lovelace","bio":null,"university":null}. Unknown users return 404.

item.name: Skills
item.description: Skill catalog is public; modifying or reading the authenticated user's skill associations requires Firebase Bearer authentication.

request.description: Returns the skill catalog. Success example: [{"id":"...","name":"C#","description":".NET"}].
Returns one skill. Success example: {"id":"...","name":"C#","description":".NET"}. Unknown IDs return 404.
Returns only the authenticated user's skills. Success example: [{"id":"...","name":"C#","description":".NET"}].

Associates an existing skill with the authenticated user's profile. Success example: {"id":"...","name":"C#","description":".NET"}. The skill ID is a path parameter, not a client-supplied user identity.
Removes the skill association from the authenticated user's profile. Success returns 204.

item.name: Interests
item.description: Interest catalog is public; profile associations are scoped to the authenticated user.

request.description: Returns the interest catalog. Success example: [{"id":"...","name":"Science","description":null}].
Returns one interest. Success example: {"id":"...","name":"Science","description":null}. Unknown IDs return 404.
Returns only the authenticated user's interests. Success example: [{"id":"...","name":"Science","description":null}].
Adds an existing interest to the authenticated user's profile. Success example: {"id":"...","name":"Science","description":null}. Duplicate association returns 409.
Removes an interest from the authenticated user's profile; success returns 204.
Returns LearningDirectionResponse objects ordered by name. Success example: [{"id":"...","name":"Backend Development","description":"Build APIs"}].
Returns a learning direction with its skills. Success example: {"id":"...","name":"Backend Development","description":"Build APIs","skills":[]}. Unknown IDs return 404.

item.name: Experiences
item.description: All experience operations are scoped to the authenticated local user.

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's experiences. Success example: [{"id":"...","userId":"...","title":"Building APIs","description":"Details"}].

Creates an experience for the authenticated user. Success example: {"id":"...","userId":"...","title":"Building APIs with ASP.NET Core","description":"Designed and implemented backend APIs."}. title is required.
Returns the experience only if it belongs to the authenticated user. Success example: {"id":"...","userId":"...","title":"Building APIs","description":"Details"}.
Updates only an experience owned by the authenticated user. Success example: {"id":"...","userId":"...","title":"Building production APIs","description":"Updated description."}.
Deletes only an experience owned by the authenticated user. Success returns 204.

item.name: Progress
item.description: Progress operations are scoped to the authenticated user. LearningDirectionId must reference an existing learning direction and each user can have one progress record per direction.

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's progress records. Success example: [{"id":"...","learningDirectionId":"...","learningDirectionName":"Backend Development","level":"Beginner","startedAt":"2026-09-19T00:00:00Z","updatedAt":"2026-09-19T00:00:00Z"}].
Creates progress for the authenticated user. Duplicate user/direction progress returns a conflict from the service/controller.

Returns a progress record only when it belongs to the authenticated user. Success example: {"id":"...","learningDirectionId":"...","learningDirectionName":"Backend Development","level":"Beginner","startedAt":"2026-09-19T00:00:00Z","updatedAt":"2026-09-19T00:00:00Z"}.

Updates only the authenticated user's progress record. Success example: {"id":"...","learningDirectionId":"...","learningDirectionName":"Backend Development","level":"Intermediate","startedAt":"2026-09-19T00:00:00Z","updatedAt":"2026-09-19T00:00:00Z"}.
Deletes only the authenticated user's progress record. Success returns 204.

item.name: Points
item.description: Protected Points API. Every request uses the authenticated local user derived from the Firebase Bearer token. Points packages are server-controlled: clients send only a package ID and required idempotency key. Simulated purchases use no real payment provider. CompleteMentoringSessionAsync exists only as a service method and is intentionally not included because no HTTP endpoint exposes it.

request.description: Returns PointsBalanceResponse. Example success: {"points":50}.

Returns only the authenticated user's ledger entries. Example item: {"id":"...","amount":-15,"transactionType":"MentoringPayment","relatedUserId":"...","mentoringSessionId":"...","reason":"Learned React from mentor","createdAt":"2026-09-19T00:00:00Z"}.
Returns the backend-defined packages. Current values: starter = 100 Points for 5 USD; standard = 250 Points for 10 USD; premium = 500 Points for 18 USD. Currency is USD.

Successful simulated purchase. The backend resolves starter to 100 Points and 5 USD, credits the authenticated user, and creates one purchase plus one Purchase transaction. Do not send UserId, Points, Price, or Balance.

item.name: Purchase Starter Package - Repeat Same Key

request.description: Retry the previous request with the same authenticated user and idempotency key. The existing purchase is returned and the user is not credited twice.
A different idempotency key represents a new intentional purchase and credits another 100 Points. The package price and points remain backend-controlled.

Returns only the authenticated user's simulated purchase records. Example: {"packageId":"starter","points":100,"price":5,"currency":"USD","paymentMethod":"Simulated","status":"Completed","balance":150}.
